message: The electricity crew has inspected the area. The sagging cable near Shivaji Market was secured and the connection point re-fixed. Please report if it sags again after rain.
The sewer crew has cleared the blocked drain in Gully Lane and jetting is complete. We are monitoring the outflow for the next two days.
Road repair work in front of Z.P. School has been scheduled under the ward resurfacing drive. Work will begin after the rains ease.
The culvert near the eroded shoulder has been inspected. Temporary barricading is placed and a permanent retaining wall repair is in the ward works list.
The door-to-door pickup schedule for this street has been corrected. The missed collections will be covered in the next round tomorrow morning.

The water main rupture at Nagar Road crossing has been repaired. The leaking collar coupling was replaced with a reinforced ductile iron sleeve and the road surface was repaved. Supply has been restored to Sectors 3 and 4.
